name: Intuit Credit Karma
description: Credit Karma helps you understand your credit health. Get a breakdown of the key factors affecting your credit score – including payment history, credit utilization, credit age, credit mix, new credit inquiries, and total accounts – and see how you're rated on each to help you take action toward improving your credit.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Intuit Credit Karma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Intuit Credit Karma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://anthropic.mcp.creditkarma.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Intuit Credit Karma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit Credit Karma provides these MCP tools: get_credit_factors.

acceptedAnswer.text: Intuit Credit Karma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
